metadata.title: Geometric quantizazion and TYCZ coefficients of HyperKähler 4-manifolds
metadata.abstract: In this paper we study conditions for the existence of a geometric quantization of a complete hyperKähler four manifold with an effective tri--Hamiltonian circle action and we show that the vanishing of the third coefficient $a_3$ associated to these metrics is equivalent to flatness.
